card.line: Ophrah was a city of the Abiezrites where Gideon lived. God called him there to save Israel, and it later became a place of idol worship and sorrow.

moments.title: The angel calls Gideon
moments.text: The angel of the LORD sat under the oak in Ophrah while Gideon threshed wheat in a winepress to hide it from the Midianites. He told Gideon to go in his strength and save Israel.

moments.title: The altar called The LORD Is Peace
moments.text: The LORD told Gideon not to be afraid, for he would not die. Gideon built an altar there and called it The LORD Is Peace. It still stood in Ophrah when this was written.

moments.title: Gideon's ephod
moments.text: Gideon made an ephod from the gold and placed it in Ophrah, his hometown. All Israel worshiped it there, and it became a snare to Gideon and his household.

moments.title: Gideon is buried
moments.text: Gideon died at a ripe old age. He was buried in the tomb of his father Joash in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

moments.title: Abimelech kills his brothers
moments.text: Abimelech went to his father's house in Ophrah and murdered his seventy brothers on one stone. Jotham, the youngest, survived because he hid himself.
